analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($70.11) vs SMA5 ($73.58) / SMA20 ($70.16) / SMA50 ($72.92) — Below SMA20, diagnosing short-to-mid term trend as weak.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($69.39) / SMA200 ($60.44) — Above SMA100, confirming medium-to-long term trend support.
· 52-week position (64.6%) — Current price level is approximately 20% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (58.8 → 46.5) — Entering oversold territory, diagnosing strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.3537 → 0.1765) — Approaching transition from positive to negative, signaling a bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $58.96, Middle $70.16) — Below the middle band, approaching the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($69.57) — Support confirmed based on Pivot S1 ($59.16) and SMA100 ($69.39).
· Swing Resistance ($76.33) — Resistance zone based on 5-day high ($77.90) and R1 ($79.47).
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern (Forming Lower High then sideways) — Uncertain trend reversal phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.04x vs 5-day average) — Normal reliability of movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Consider buying after RSI exits oversold and MACD improves, consider selling upon breaking swing resistance.
